meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能直接操作生物进化树文件:读取/转换 Newick 等格式,裁剪、重新生根、比较两棵树,识别基因复制与分化事件,查询 NCBI 分类并标注物种,还能把树画成 PDF/SVG 图。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理或比较进化树、查询/标注物种分类,或把树渲染成图时触发;不用于从原始序列推断树,须先做序列比对和建树。

say.text: 帮我读入 tree.nw,按 midpoint 重新生根,输出 PDF 图。
say.note: 会调用脚本完成重根并渲染。

say.text: 给这棵树的叶子加上 NCBI 分类谱系,并标出物种名。
say.note: 用 NCBITaxa 查询谱系并添加特征。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can work directly with phylogenetic tree files: read/convert Newick and related formats, prune and reroot trees, compare two trees, identify gene duplication and speciation events, query NCBI taxonomy to annotate species, and render trees as PDF/SVG figures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to process or compare phylogenetic trees, query/annotate species taxonomy, or render trees as images. It should not be used to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and build a tree first.

say_en.text: Read tree.nw, reroot at midpoint, and output a PDF figure.
Compare gene_tree.nw and species_tree.nw with Robinson-Foulds distance.
say_en.note: Returns RF distance and unique branches.

say_en.text: Add NCBI taxonomic lineages to the leaves and label species names.
say_en.note: Uses NCBITaxa to query lineages and annotate.
